title: Global morphogenetic flow: scout seed DOI mismatches the Streichan 2018 eLife bib entry
instructions: Identify the actual Streichan et al. 2018 Global morphogenetic flow article from Crossref/eLife and reconcile scout_manifest seed_doi with the primary bib entry and seed_landmark_paper.
Correct only the erroneous provenance field; preserve any genuinely distinct citing DOI as a secondary citation rather than deleting evidence.
Record both DOIs, article title evidence, and the reason one is primary in the fixer report.

validators.name: GMF DOI consistency
argv: import json,pathlib; m=json.load(open('datasets/global_morphogenetic_flow/scout_manifest.json')); b=pathlib.Path('datasets/global_morphogenetic_flow/paper_citations.bib').read_text(); assert '10.7554/eLife.27454' in b; print(m)
